en.title: Minimum Binary Subsequence Errors After Replacing Wildcards
en.description:
Replace each ! independently with 0 or 1. Every pair of indices i<j that forms 01 contributes x, and every pair that forms 10 contributes y; this is not limited to adjacent characters. Minimize the full cost, then take it modulo 1000000007.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains a non-empty string consisting only of 0, 1 and !; the second line contains x y. Length ≤100000, 0≤x,y≤100000.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The answers are 9, 0 and 6; in the second example, replacing to get 11 produces no errors.
hints: If x>y, reverse the string and swap x,y so that x≤y. Some optimal solution assigns the wildcards 0s first and then 1s by position; start with all 1s, change them to 0 one by one while maintaining the 0/1 counts on the left and right and the incremental cost, and enumerate every split point.
